 2022年春学期境外学历生缴费指引 2022 Spring Semester Payment Guidelines for Degree Students outside of Mainland China
 作者：        发布时间：2022-02-14 16:54        点击数：
 境外学历生缴费指引
 一、缴费时间
 请于北京时间2022年2月15日0：00 — 2月28日23:59前完成学费缴纳或转账。
 二、缴费金额
 学费与2021年秋学期学费一致
 三、缴纳方式
 缴费方式（一）：可以使用中国版支付宝或微信支付的学生请联系邮箱cieoffice@szu.edu.cn获取学费二维码扫码缴费。（优先推荐）
 缴费方式（二）：不能扫码支付的学生将学费以人民币或等额美金汇款至深圳大学账户，转账备注栏必须填写“学生护照号+tuition”。转账支付学费的学生必须发送邮件到邮箱cieoffice@szu.edu.cn，否则无法确认缴费。
 1、邮件标题:“转账支付+学生护照号”；
 2、邮件正文: 学生姓名、转款人姓名；
 3、附件：转款人护照图片、转账凭证截图
 备注：1、需要发票的请在邮件正文说明。
       2、转账支付的学费不能退费。
 深圳大学账户信息如下：
 开 户 名：深圳大学
 账    号：748467064612
 开户银行：中国银行深圳深大支行
 地    址：中国深圳市南山区南海大道3688号深圳大学教学楼1楼中国银行深大支行
 SWIFT CODE: BKCHCNBJ45A
    深圳大学国际交流学院
                                       2022年2月13日
 Payment Guidelines for Degree Students outside of Mainland China
 1.Tuition Payment Deadline:
 Please complete tuition payment or transfer before February 28, 2022(starting from February 15, 2022) in China Standard Time.
 2.Amount of Tuition Fees: 
 Tuition: Same amount as fall semester 2021
 3.Methods of Payment
 3.1 Method A：
 Students who can use the Chinese version of Alipay or WeChat Pay, please contact cieoffice@szu.edu.cn to get Payment QR code and scan the code to pay the tuition. (Recommended)
 3.2 Method B:
  Students who can not scan the QR code to pay, please remit the tuition fees in RMB or in the equivalent amount of U.S. dollars to the bank account of Shenzhen University. The transfer remarks column must be filled with "student passport number + tuition". Students who pay for tuition by transfer need to send an email to cieoffice@szu.edu.cn，otherwise, the payment cannot be confirmed. The email should provide the following information as required:
 a.Email subject: "Transfer Payment + Student Passport Number";
 b.The body of the email: the name of the student and the name of the transferor;
 c.Attachments: A picture of the transferor’s passport and a screenshot of the transfer receipt;
 NB: 1.If you need an invoice, please note in the body of the email.
     2.The tuition paid by bank transfer is non-refundable.
 Account information of Shenzhen University is as follows:
